company_name: ABV ENGINEERS AND CONSULTANTS PVT LTD
semiconductor_relevance: Low — The company's involvement in the semiconductor industry is primarily through its joint venture focusing on motor sales, which is not a core semiconductor activity.
summary: ABV Engineers and Consultants Pvt Ltd is involved in the semiconductor value chain through its joint venture Aspina ABV Technologies Pvt Ltd, which promotes Hybrid Stepper and BLDC motors in India and neighboring countries. The company also specializes in heavy metal fabrication and operates as an authorized Hardox processing center for high-quality wear parts.
capabilities: Heavy metal fabrication for customized components
Authorized Hardox processing for wear parts

regional_presence.India: The company promotes sales of motors and engages in fabrication activities within India.
